metadata.scope: Butt hinges with screw leaves and knurled finials, print-in-place hinges, ball joints, snap-fit cantilever hooks, living hinges, clevis joints.

material_suggestions.notes: Better fatigue resistance than PLA for repeated flex; 0.35 mm clearance.

material_suggestions.notes: 0.5–0.8 mm thickness for living hinge; very low insertion force.

material_suggestions.use_case: light-duty one-shot snap fits and prototype hinges
material_suggestions.notes: Brittle under repeated flex; use only for low-cycle applications.

standards_used.name: Snap-fit beam deflection limit
standards_used.note: Max strain = hook_height / (arm_length × factor); keep < 70% yield for PLA (2.5%), PETG (3.5%).

standards_used.name: ISO 286-1
standards_used.note: 0.3–0.4 mm gap between pin and barrel for printed assembly.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: FDM print-in-place hinge mechanism

knuckle_l.note: Each of the 5 knuckles gets equal width. NEVER use leaf_length/(2*knuckle_count-1) — that gives 9 knuckle slots.

n_a.note: Integer division. For knuckle_count=5 → n_a=3 (leaf A: knuckles 1,3,5).

n_b.note: Integer division. For knuckle_count=5 → n_b=2 (leaf B: knuckles 2,4).

knuckle_OD.note: Outer diameter of knuckle barrel (wall ≥ 1.5 mm).

knuckle_z.note: Z-centre of all knuckle cylinders — knuckles sit on top of the leaf plates.

barrel_bore.note: Bore in leaf B barrels. Must be > pin_d for rotation.

main_features: use only when the prompt explicitly asks for print-in-place, FDM, printable, clearance, rotating after printing, or snapfit printed hinge behavior
pin axis along X — all knuckle cylinders use rotate([0,90,0]) and share y=0, z=knuckle_z
leaf A: n_a=3 barrel cylinders at x = k/2, 5k/2, 9k/2, OD=knuckle_OD, bore=bore_a
leaf B: n_b=2 barrel cylinders at x = 3k/2, 7k/2, OD=knuckle_OD, bore=barrel_bore
leaf A plate extends in +Y from the hinge joint (clearance gap from y=0)
leaf B plate extends in -Y from the hinge joint (clearance gap from y=0)
clearance gap between leaf plates in Y so they can rotate after printing
not for butt hinge hardware, door hinge reference images, Emtek style hinges, countersunk screw-hole hinges, visible-pin hinges, or knurled-finial hinges
design_rules: Select this record only for explicit print-in-place / FDM printable hinge prompts. For butt hinge, door hinge, Emtek reference image, rectangular leaves, countersunk screw holes, visible continuous pin, or knurled finials, use butt_hinge_knurled_finials instead.
knuckle_l = leaf_length / knuckle_count. NEVER use leaf_length/(2*knuckle_count-1) — wrong formula.
Leaf A loop: for(i=[0:n_a-1]) with x_c = (2*i)*knuckle_l + knuckle_l/2. n_a=3 for 5-knuckle.
Leaf B loop: for(i=[0:n_b-1]) with x_c = (2*i+1)*knuckle_l + knuckle_l/2. n_b=2 for 5-knuckle.
ALL knuckle cylinders share the SAME axis: y=0, z=knuckle_z. Pin axis is along X (rotate([0,90,0])). NEVER use rotate([90,0,0]) — that points cylinders along Y, destroying the shared axis.

Both leaf A and leaf B knuckles use difference(): solid outer cylinder OD=knuckle_OD minus bore. Leaf A bore = pin_d + clearance; leaf B bore = pin_d + 2*clearance. NEVER use d=pin_d for a knuckle outer cylinder because the bore is larger than the outside and the knuckle disappears.
Do NOT use minkowski(), sphere(), or filleted_cylinder() for hinge bores; use plain cylinder subtraction to avoid deleting the barrel.
Leaf A plate: translate([0, clearance, 0]) cube([leaf_length, leaf_width, leaf_thick]).
Leaf B plate: translate([0, -(leaf_width+clearance), 0]) cube([leaf_length, leaf_width, leaf_thick]).
Do NOT span full leaf_width with a single cylinder — that gives one continuous tube, not interleaved knuckles.
Do not define fillet_r or chamfer_r. Do not create chamfered_plate(). Hinge leaves are plain cube plates; hinge bores are plain cylinder subtractions.
Do not use this print-in-place schema for visual butt hinge hardware with screw holes, continuous pin, or decorative tips.
validation_criteria: leaf A loop runs exactly n_a=(knuckle_count+1)/2=3 iterations for 5-knuckle
leaf B loop runs exactly n_b=(knuckle_count-1)/2=2 iterations for 5-knuckle
all cylinders use rotate([0,90,0]) — axis along X
all knuckle centers are at y=0, z=knuckle_z (shared axis)
both leaf A and leaf B knuckles use difference() with outer d=knuckle_OD and bore subtraction
no knuckle outer cylinder uses d=pin_d
leaf A bore = pin_d + clearance; leaf B bore = pin_d + 2*clearance
leaf plates have clearance gap in Y between them
failure_modes: knuckle_l = leaf_length/(2*knuckle_count-1) — gives 4.4mm instead of 8mm; 9 knuckle slots total
leaf A loop [0:knuckle_count-1] = 5 knuckles, leaf B [0:knuckle_count-2] = 4 knuckles — 9 total instead of 5
rotate([90,0,0]) on cylinders — axis along Y, each knuckle on different axis, not a hinge
leaf A cylinders use d=pin_d or are added without difference() - bore may be larger than outer diameter or pin will fuse to barrel
leaf B at z=leaf_thick+clearance with barrel at z=0 relative — pin and barrel offset by clearance in Z, not coaxial
cylinder h=leaf_width spanning full barrel width — single continuous tube, not interleaved knuckles
minkowski() or filleted_cylinder() used for bore fillets - over-subtracts and can delete the barrel
fillet_r/chamfer_r/chamfered_plate added from generic FDM rules - distracts from hinge mechanics and often triggers minkowski over-subtraction

constraint_checks.message: Hinge barrel bore must be pin_d + 2*clearance for freedom of movement.

design_rules: This is the preferred record whenever a prompt says butt hinge, door hinge, Emtek, reference image, photo, rectangular leaves, countersunk screw holes, visible pin, continuous pin, knurled finials, or knurled hinge tips.
This is a butt hinge / hardware reference, not a print-in-place hinge.
Never answer a butt hinge hardware prompt with print_in_place_hinge_5knuckle.
Use rectangular leaves left/right of a central barrel.
Use screw_hole() with screw and countersink cylinders directly inside rotate([90,0,0]).
Use leaf(side) with cube([leaf_w, leaf_t, hinge_h], center=true). Do not use cube([hinge_h, leaf_w, leaf_t]).
Use barrel_d directly for knuckle(len); do not derive a separate knuckle_OD from pin_d + wall.
Use a visible continuous pin cylinder: cylinder(h = hinge_h + 2 * finial_len, d = pin_d).
Use knurled_finial() with repeated cube cuts controlled by knurl_count.
Use five barrel knuckles with loops for [0,2,4] and [1,3].
Do not use hinge_leaf_a, hinge_leaf_b, bore_a, bore_b, knuckle_z, leaf_gap, clear_gap, or clearance leaf layout.
Do not use minkowski(), fillet_r, chamfer_r, tolerance block variables, or manufacturing string variables.
validation_criteria: leaf(side) module creates two rectangular leaves left/right of central barrel
screw_hole() creates through screw cut and countersink cut directly, without nested difference()
knuckle(len) subtracts pin_d bore from barrel_d cylinder
no hinge_leaf_a, hinge_leaf_b, bore_a, bore_b, knuckle_z, leaf_gap, clear_gap, or clearance leaf layout
